Rashi on Nedarim 41a:1:1.english: And a rug - A hide to eat upon.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:1:2.english: Without salt and without fat - with which he seasons [his bread].

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:2:1.hebrew: דדא ביה כולא ביה - מי שיש בו דעת, כמי שיש בו הכל, שאינו נחסר כלום:
Rashi on Nedarim 41a:2:1.english: [One] who has this in him, everything [is] in him - One who has intelligence [is] like one who has everything, for he lacks nothing.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:2:2.english: [If] he acquired this, what is lacking? - One who has acquired knowledge is lacking nothing.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:3:1.english: [He] returns to the days of his youth - For he becomes like a child who has not tasted the taste of sin.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:3:2.hebrew: שנא' רוטפש - כלומר, כשעת רטוב ופש, כמו [פרו ורבו מתרגמינן] פושו וסגו:
Rashi on Nedarim 41a:3:2.english: As it is stated: Rutpash [is tenderer] - That is to say, like a time of [being] moist [ratov] and flourishing [pash], as [“be fruitful and multiply” is translated into Aramaic as] pushu usegu [increase and multiply].

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:3:3.hebrew: מנוער - מן החולי, ישוב כמו שהיה בימי עלומיו:
Rashi on Nedarim 41a:3:3.english: Meno'ar [from youth] - [Shaken free] from the illness, he will return [to be] as he was in the days of his youth.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:3:4.english: You overturned all his lying down in his illness - The entire order of the arrangement of his learning that was set in order for him is overturned for him in his illness, and he forgets it.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:5:1.hebrew: תליסר אפי הלכתא - שהיה שונה למודו בי"ג פנים:
Rashi on Nedarim 41a:5:1.english: Thirteen aspects of a halakha - For he would review his study in thirteen ways.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:5:2.english: Six went away from him - [Meaning] that he forgot them.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:5:4.hebrew: אתה עשית אותי ואת חייא - דגמר להו, דכל המלמד את בן חברו תורה מעלה עליו הכתוב כאילו עשאו, שנאמר: "ואת הנפש אשר עשו בחרן":
Rashi on Nedarim 41a:5:4.english: You made me and Ḥiyya - Because he taught them, for whoever teaches his fellow's son Torah, Scripture credits him as if he had made him, as it is stated: "And the souls that they had made in Haran" [Genesis 12:5].

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:7:1.hebrew: הכל מושלין בו - להמיתו, אפי' זבוב, אפילו יתוש:
Rashi on Nedarim 41a:7:1.english: Everything has dominion over him - To kill him — even a fly, even a mosquito.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:7:2.hebrew: למשפטיך עמדו היום כל עבדיך - דכיון שנשפט בישיבה של מעלה, הכל נעשו עבדיו של הקב"ה ליפרע הימנו:
Rashi on Nedarim 41a:7:2.english: They stand this day according to Your judgments, all [are] Your servants - For once [a person] is judged in the heavenly academy, all become servants of the Holy One, Blessed be He, to exact retribution from him.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:8:1.english: A tall man was riding a small girdana - A small mule.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:8:3.hebrew: ואסתויט - נתפחדה הפרדה, ושדייה מינה ושכיב. ואע"פ שהפרדה נמוכה ואיהו היה ארוך כל כך דלא נפל אלא מעט, מת:
Rashi on Nedarim 41a:8:3.english: And [it] was frightened - The mule became frightened, and threw him off it, and he died. And even though the mule was low and he was so tall that he fell only a little, he died.

Rashi on Nedarim 41a:9:1.hebrew: אקרוקתא - צפרדע. ועקרב אינו יכול לשוט בנהר, ונשאו צפרדע עליו להעבירו בנהר לנשוך את האיש:
Rashi on Nedarim 41a:9:1.english: Akrukta - A frog. And a scorpion cannot swim in a river, and a frog carried it upon itself to take it across the river to bite the man.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:10:1.english: Whom fever overcame - [This means] that his fever has taken hold [of him] and he is still sick.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:1:1.hebrew: שטיח - עור מבושל שאוכלין עליו, ונושאין אותו עוברי דרכים עמם:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:1:1.english: A rug - Tanned leather upon which they eat, and wayfarers carry it with them.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:2:1.english: One who has this in him - [That is,] one who has intelligence in him.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:2:2.hebrew: דא לא קני - דעה, מה קני:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:2:2.english: [If] he has not acquired this - [i.e.,] intelligence, what has he acquired?

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:3:1.english: “Who forgives all your iniquity; Who heals all your diseases”:

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:3:2.english: He returns to the days of his youth - [This means] that the sick person is healthier when he recovers than [he was] before he fell ill.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:5:1.hebrew: תליסר אפי הלכתא - י"ג פנים של הלכות משנה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:5:1.english: Thirteen aspects of a halakha - Thirteen aspects of the halakhot of the Mishnah.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:5:2.english: You made Ḥiyya - That is to say, you taught him.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:7:1.hebrew: למשפטיך - כלומר, כשעמדו בריותיך למשפטיך, הכל עבדים להביא עליהם מה שצוית:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:7:1.english: For Your judgments - That is to say, when Your creatures stand for Your judgments, all are servants to bring upon them what You have commanded:

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:8:1.english: Gavra rabbah - A great [or tall] man.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41a:8:3.english: Ityutei - [This means] he became frightened, like [the phrase] "kama tiyuta naktei" [fright seized the first one] in Bava Kamma (37b).
